verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs describe a built-in AI connector that 'handles that setup for you,' so users add AI features by describing them. The built-in Cloud backend is documented as including AI with no infrastructure setup required. Missing for 10: explicit statement that provider API keys are managed by Lovable (it is only implied by 'handles that setup'), evidence of support for agent-style features beyond LLM calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
